name: copilot-quota-monitor
description: Shows GitHub Copilot quota, remaining allowance, and reset date in the VS Code status bar.

copilotQuota.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh Copilot quota information.

copilotQuota.quotaType.description: SDK quota key to display. The default key, premium_interactions, appears as Premium model. Other common keys are chat and completions.

copilotQuota.showResetDate.description: Show the quota reset date in the status bar tooltip.

copilotQuota.cycleResetDay.description: Day of the month (00:00 UTC) when the allowance resets. Used when the API does not report a future reset date, which is the case for token-based (AI Credits) billing where resetDate is just the snapshot time. GitHub AI Credits reset on the 1st. Set to 0 to disable projections in that case.

copilotQuota.costPerRequestUsd.description: USD value of one quota unit, used to show cost estimates. GitHub AI Credits are $0.01 each; legacy request-based plans charge $0.04 per additional premium request. Set to 0 to hide cost estimates.

copilotQuota.spikeHourlyPercent.description: Warn when more than this percentage of the monthly allowance is consumed within one hour (1% per hour is roughly 7x the pace that would last the full month). Set to 0 to disable spike warnings.
